review: Read-only source and pinned Forge 1.20.1 bytecode review; no Minecraft or Gradle launched by reviewer.

proof: ChunkStatus FEATURES bytecode creates WorldGenRegion with write radius 1 and passes ServerLevel.structureManager().forWorldGenRegion(region) to ChunkGenerator.applyBiomeDecoration.
StructureManager.startsForStructure(ChunkPos, Predicate) reads its current chunk at STRUCTURE_REFERENCES.
StructureManager.fillStartsForStructure reads referenced owner chunks at STRUCTURE_STARTS. It does not request FULL chunks.
The RETURN injection retains this supplied region-bound manager; it does not substitute the live ServerLevel manager.

ordering_and_safety: Natural placement runs the final tree pass after the current chunk has completed its structure and ordinary vegetation stages.
SavannaOrcCampPiece initializes its GroundPlan, places clipped mound/template blocks, records planting masks and refreshes WG heightmaps before the final pass.
Each newly generated tree is staged in GrowthPlacementBuffer; every proposed write must remain in its owning chunk and pass the complete-tree reservation rules before commit.
Later neighboring camp placement is clipped to that neighboring chunk, so it cannot erase the new tree writes retained entirely in this owner chunk.

The Orcz /place feature path completes every mound/template chunk before SavannaCampVegetation.decoratePlaced. The /place structure return hook similarly decorates only after native structure placement.
Command decoration refreshes all affected pre-tree WG snapshots first, then runs each chunk normal vegetation followed by its guaranteed-tree pass under the existing mound/reservation scope.
Existing rooted acacia detection prevents repeat filling. V7 and older saved camps and non-Savanna dimensions return before the new tree scan.
performance_scope: The pass scans 256 columns only in chunks referenced by a V8 camp. It uses a separate deterministic random source, preserving ordinary feature random sequences.
The five-by-five lawn prefilter excludes thin margins and protected plots before native tree generation; candidate search is finite and commits at most one new tree per chunk.
No new global tree density, terrain formula, ordinary non-camp decoration or older-camp vegetation rule is changed.

previous_fixture_finding.issue: The initial detached tree fixture did not initialize the piece GroundPlan, causing hasMoundColumn to reject every root before generation.
